revocation.plainReport: reporter-local hide and no-refill only; does not revoke another accepted target
revocation.senderDelete: deny every future open, cancel matching work through generation-bound paths, tombstone pinned cache and remove unpinned cache
revocation.moderatorDelete: same global future-open and cache revocation as sender delete with audited authority

revocation.ownerActorOrOrbitDisable: uniform 404 for every future open and no refill
revocation.alreadyOpenBoundedRead: may finish at most the current verified 1 MiB chunk; grants no later open
